source_data_selection: from original SHA-sorted ARC-Challenge train eligible four-single-token-answer Qwen chat input, indices 128 through 175 inclusive, first24 optimization train, next24 independent source diagnostic; source original Qv6 first128 verified unchanged
validation_selection: for each subject sort SHA256(datasetRevision+'/test/'+subject+'/'+rowIndex) ascending, include first24 unique exact 4-option single-letter Qwen chat prompts, 18<=tokens<=208; never use correct answer labels to tune allocation
evaluation_provenance: MMLU public test questions provide exploratory domain shift, not model-pretraining-unseen heldout or official unbiased MMLU accuracy
sensitivity_method: conditional four-token output Gauss-Newton at original BF16 Qwen W; for each source train case retain BF16 logits A/B/C/D; exactly 3 BF16 backward passes of z_A-z_D, z_B-z_D, z_C-z_D; contract each with native Q4G64/n8 weight residual to get per-token J(delta)
gauss_newton_definition: p=softmax(original BF16 logits of four choice letters). For each policy x, Δu_sk(x)=Σ_i ∂(z_sk-z_sD)/∂W_i [Q_{b_i}(W_i)-W_i]; Δu_sD=0; GGN_s=0.5*(Σ_k p_sk Δu_sk²-(Σ_k p_sk Δu_sk)²); empirical conditional-four-choice (not full-vocab) output Hessian J^T(diag(p)-pp^T)J/2.
regularized_model_objective: fixed precommitted ridge_alpha=0.35 times isolated per-tensor conditional output GGN sum_i 0.5 Var_p(Δu_i) scaled by selected-mask per-sample, plus (1-ridge_alpha) total joint conditional GGN; robust objective=max(mean train fold-even,mean train fold-odd) over 24 source training cases. Nonnegative PSD surrogate.
source_folds: train 24 pairs even index (12) vs odd (12) from locked source train; optimize minimax two folds, do not tune alpha using 24 source-diagnostic or 48 validation labels
confidence_diagnostic: frozen source diagnostic 24 original BF16 conditional GGN scores captured AFTER mask frozen, never used for source fit, only evaluate relative forecast to original prior policies
global_optimality_policy: source-constrained 28/196 n8, 168 q4, 830570496 projection-byte ceiling, <=100ms serial CPU kernel source cost proxy, <=50ms isolated async source stage; deterministic source-only multi-start feasible 1-swap local search; no global MILP quadratic optimum claim
primary_quality_metrics: native BEGLIN Qwen 28layer full-vocabulary correct-label next-token NLL and four-option accuracy on same 48 MMLU questions
secondary_metric: separate original HF BF16 MPS correct-label NLL, not arithmetic parity with native C widened-F32
statistical_policy: preselected 48 x 5 arms, paired bootstrap 5000 fixed seed 20261023, McNemar exact exploratory; no multiplicity correction so no generalization claim even on significant result
scientific_safety: GGN is conditional 4-choice output curvature and captures only local Jacobian effects; it is not true full-vocab NLL Hessian, exact Hessian of full model, nor predictive proof of quantized model output; large ∆ may invalidate first-order linearization
pass_gate: source signed conditional Jacobian 24 train, robust ridge policy SHA, new eval dataset 48 native apples CPU, independently verified private logs and classification; generalized quality and latency promotion prohibited
